name: Notices
text: All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed duly given when delivered by registered post, courier, or electronic mail to the addresses specified by the Parties.
title: Notices
dispute_hotspots: Service of termination notice — RPAD vs email — courts require reliable evidence of receipt
Stale addresses — Party moved without updating — notice deemed served at old address
Public holiday — notice arriving on holiday — deemed date of service
statute_currency: CITATION OUT OF DATE - S.65B (admissibility of electronic records). The Indian Evidence Act, 1872 was repealed with effect from 1 July 2024 by the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023. The principle relied on here survives the repeal, but the SECTION NUMBER does not carry across - the Adhiniyam renumbered throughout. Published correspondence tables circulating online disagree with one another, so the advocate must map this citation against the bare Adhiniyam text rather than a table, and record the confirmed section here.
